title: AUDIT-7 Lane 7 slice B: remaining orphaned open issues in code (~49) + needs-parent triage
body: After Lane 7 batches 1-2 (34 orphans linked, see code#13874), ~49 OPEN issues in developing-today/code remain with no parent label and no issue reference in the body (orphan list in the Lane 7 report doc). For each, one by one, read in full incl. comments (per_page=100, count-confirmed; lane claim = hard stop): assign the appropriate maintenance epic (id #12462, fleet #12460, mcpx #12459, atlas #12457, pm-stack #12458, lab-cluster #12461, main-broken #8976, scheduled-tasks #8979, daily-maintenance #8978, design-register #8986) as sub-issue + labels stray-work, epic/<slug>, primary-parent/<slug>; or label stray/needs-parent and propose a new parent on #13874 where none fits. Also triage items labelled stray/needs-parent in slice A.

payload.risk: low: label + sub-issue metadata only, no code changes, no closes
tests: readback via fleet gh api: parent sub_issues list contains child; child labels contain stray-work + primary-parent/*
